verification.selector: Governed lane-schema evolution unit and integration suite
Combined lane schema, builder, bundle, reader, and custom-schema regression surface
Python lint, compile, policy/registry JSON, and whitespace validation
verification.result: Ruff, py_compile, json.tool, and git diff --check passed

negative_cases: Raw SQL, unsafe identifiers, noncontiguous versions, core-table ALTER, nonnullable ADD_COLUMN, malformed operations, and duplicate names fail before execution.
A foreign key targeting a missing table or column rolls back the extension DDL and the ledger infrastructure atomically.
A repeated migration ID with identical bytes is idempotent; the same ID with different bytes fails as an immutable conflict.
Ledger UPDATE and DELETE operations abort through SQLite triggers.
A missing or mismatched protected-code-lane confirmation leaves sqlite_master byte-identical and creates no migration ledger.
No migration action creates a candidate, invokes HIL, or moves a Project Truth pointer.
limitations: Row213 implements the internal governed schema-evolution engine; public SDK, MCP, command, and owning-skill routes remain governed by their queued parity rows.
The compiler returns the exact code-lane confirmation text as a proposed user control, but no runtime may infer or auto-submit it.
Lane artifact role expansion remains Row214; bounded query guidance and parallel/cross-lane/project execution remain Rows215-218.
next_boundary: Close Row213 through its exact per-Delta checkpoint. Row214 EL-CODEX-T6-PARITY-017-LANE-ARTIFACT-CONTRACT owns required, conditional, optional, and validated extension artifact roles without changing unrelated lanes.
